filesystem_scan.scope: scripts/scan.py may read directory metadata under the default hotspot roots or --include-system-apps Program Files. It must skip junctions/symlinks and write only an optional absolute --output JSON.
filesystem_scan.reason: A storage report needs local size inventory.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must authorize directory reads.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash may run the helper; scan remains non-mutating aside from optional JSON output.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to scan arbitrary disks.

filesystem_trash.scope: server.py may move allowlisted paths to Trash after this-turn approval. Green paths must match cache-prefixes.json and stay under the user home. Yellow trash must be listed and approved. Tests must use --check-allowlist or --stub-actions.
filesystem_trash.reason: Optional reclaim after review. Recycle Bin is the only mutation.

target_enforcement.openai: Host must require this-turn path approval before server.py.
target_enforcement.claude: SKILL forbids server.py without this-turn approval.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to trash files.

filesystem_delete.scope: v1 must not expose rm, shutil.rmtree, or OS permanent delete.
filesystem_delete.reason: Hard delete is irreversible and was removed from the public contract.

network.scope: Optional server.py binds 127.0.0.1 only. No outbound network.
